notes.title: New Quality of Life update
notes.content:
Hello!

Extortion will be 4 years old next week !

I've been working on some quality of life fixes today to change my mind from working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146380/Manufactur_inc/]Manufactur'inc[/url] demo, my factory management game.

Lots of things we talked about in the Steam Forum, on Discord and in early october IRL convention (my first one!).

Changes:
[list]
[*] #1822 - Handle ~ and $PWD when navigating in folders / opening files
[*] Fix save delete image on small screens
[*] #1823 - When restoring a save it sometimes miss informations
[*] #1820 - SCP should handle multiple arguments and download them all
[*] #1775 - You are not able to go in the parent directory of "/" anymore
[*] #1773 - Autocompletion doesn't work with clearLogs command
[*] #1660 - User shouldn't be able to type while commands are running
[*] #1659 - When a user doesn't exist, passwordBruteForce shouldn't reply "Password found: ?" but an error
[*] #1658 - Fullscreen/Windowed modes
[*] #649 - Copy/Paste (select then CTRL + C to copy, CTRL + V to paste)
[*] [u]Developer side:[/u] Update lots of technical dependencies
[/list]

I hope you'll enjoy this update and the game :)
Have a good day!

Elanis

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Localization + New Translation system
notes.content:
Hello there!

[url=https://github.com/Dysnomia-Studio/extortion-i18n/pull/2]One month ago, on Github[/url], one of you submitted a draft to translation extortion to Simplified Chinese. I am extremely happy people take this time to translate the game into their language, so I took time to (try to) review everything and improve the translation system to have a qualitative version.

This update carries a stable version of this simplified Chinese version as well as the new translation system.

[b]Wait! I found a bug. How do I give feedback?[/b]
[list]
[*] On a new post in the Steam forum
[*] On [url=https://discord.com/invite/c8aARey]Discord[/url]
[/list]

I also want to talk about another project I am working on. If you like industry management games where we talk about ethics, optimizations, and lots of other stuff, take a look at my next game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146380/Manufactur_inc/]Manufactur'inc[/url]. There already have two DevBlog about the game, and two more are planned in the following weeks!

If you're interested in the game, please wishlist and/or follow it! It would mean a great deal to me.

Thanks again for your support,
Elanis

notes.title: [Beta] Simplified Chinese and new translation system
notes.content:
Hello there!

[url=https://github.com/Dysnomia-Studio/extortion-i18n/pull/2]One month ago, on Github[/url], one of you submitted a draft to translation extortion to Simplified Chinese. I am extremely happy people take this time to translate the game into their language, so I took time to (try to) review everything and improve the translation system to have a qualitative version.

I already applied this version to the Store page and achievements, but I am now here to ask players (you!) for help with the game itself.
Since I had to change lots of stuff, this specific update will also impact French, English, and Swedish versions in addition to this new Simplified Chinese version.

So, what am I asking? Download the beta version and launch a new game (this is important, it won't affect already done actions in-game), and play the game. If you notice any issues with the text formatting or content, I'd love to hear from you before I release this update.

So, [b]how to play beta[/b]?
[list]
[*] Restart your Steam client
[*] Go into game settings via the gear icon on the top right
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856839/fa17d21e20d97c6a09f4b3fdbfcd8184b7f64e1d.png[/img]
[*] switching branch to "beta"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856839/b05021256632dc2957ecbc71121be92ca2a33fc5.png[/img]
[*] Wait for the update
[*] Play!
[/list]

And [b]how to give feedback[/b]?
[list]
[*] Here, in the comments
[*] On [url=https://discord.com/invite/c8aARey]Discord[/url]
[*] On the [url=https://github.com/Dysnomia-Studio/extortion-i18n/pull/2]Github pull request[/url]
[/list]

Thank you to anyone willing to help me test this update <3
Elanis

notes.title: Price update following Steam Recommandation
notes.content:
Hello !

As you can see on Steam right now, recommanded prices have been updated by Valve for developers.

Immediatly with theses recommanded prices, I adjusted price of both Dysnomia games to keep the same euro price.

What does that mean ?

Most prices will fluctuate between -15% and +20%:
- US Dollar prices lowered by 17% to 4.99$ (-1$)
- British pound prices lowered by 11% to 4.29£ (-0.5£)
- Canadian dollar prices lowered by 3% to 6.49$ (-0.2$)
- Russian ruble increased by 29% to 200₽ (+46₽)
And so on

You can see price variations on SteamDb by selecting your currency: https://steamdb.info/app/1299430/

Have fun !
Elanis

notes.title: 1st birthday update !
notes.content:
Hello !

Yesterday was the 1st birthday of Extortion Release. I worked a bit during the last weeks to make a small update and improve game architecture to make next updates easier.

There will be still updates, you can follow next update(s) roadmap at: https://bugs.dysnomia.studio/projects/hacking-game/roadmap

Have fun !

----

Full changelog:

Improvements:
 - #1104, #1106 - Improved French texts (better wording, fix typos)
 - #1106 - Improved English texts (better wording, fix typos)
 - Improved game files support for new languages
 - #946 - Added more automated tests to the game (especially around autocompletion)
 - Updated technical dependancies to improve performances & safety
 - Improved console design
 - Improved text contrast

Added:
 - #1023 - Narrator message when firewall goes to 0
 - #1238 - Added update automation to make me easily update the game
